top_signals.title: US stats agency change set to lower Fed’s preferred inflation gauge
top_signals.summary: Adjustments by Bureau of Economic Analysis to ease pressure on central bank to raise rates
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Zijin Gold’s Allied Deal Scrapped in Favor of $295 Million Stake
top_signals.summary: Zijin Gold International Co.’s deal to acquire Canada’s Allied Gold Corp. has been scrapped, with the Chinese mining company opting instead to invest about $295 million in the African-focused gold producer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan Sees Treasury Avoiding Bond Sales Tweak Due to Midterms
top_signals.summary: The US Treasury will avoid rattling bond markets ahead of crucial midterm elections, holding off on changes that would introduce the possibility of bigger bond sales in its quarterly refunding statement next week, according to JPMorgan Chase and Co. strategists.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The systemic-risk debate over perpetual futures is aimed at the wrong target
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: MoonPay launches PayBox, an AI payment vault for ChatGPT and Claude
top_signals.summary: Crypto payments company MoonPay now lets users move money through ChatGPT and Claude with a new AI payment vault called PayBox.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Ford, GM Defense, BC Customs to compete for US Army’s new infantry squad vehicle
top_signals.summary: Ford, GM Defense and BC Customs will build competing prototypes of the U.S. Army's future infantry squad vehicle.
